admin_purpose: Manage accounts, the administrator role and the right to create projects.
app_description: Agree on the data elements of a clinical model, from scope to hand-off.
board_purpose: The candidate elements of the concept, with their sources, comments and links to CKM.
common_error_body: This page could not be loaded. Try again, or go back to your projects.
common_error_unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
common_not_found_body: This page does not exist, or you have no access to it.
common_refusal_already_invited: This e-mail address already has an open invitation to this project.
common_refusal_already_member: This person is already a member of the project.
common_refusal_ckm_already_imported: This archetype is already imported into the project.
common_refusal_ckm_element_not_found: This archetype element no longer exists in CKM.
common_refusal_ckm_no_elements: This archetype has no elements to import.
common_refusal_ckm_refused: CKM refused the request. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_revision_changed: The archetype has a new revision in CKM. Open it again and check the element.
common_refusal_ckm_timeout: CKM took too long to answer. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_unreachable: CKM cannot be reached. Try again later.
common_refusal_ckm_unusable: CKM sent an answer this app cannot read.
common_refusal_closes_at_past: The closing date must be in the future.
common_refusal_element_has_values: This element has proposed values that do not fit the new data type. Remove those values first.
common_refusal_element_in_round: One of these elements is in a rating round, so you cannot merge them.
common_refusal_element_not_found: This element no longer exists, or it was merged into another element.
common_refusal_element_not_in_round: This element is not part of this round.
common_refusal_forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
common_refusal_group_name_taken: Another stakeholder group in this project already has this name.
common_refusal_group_not_empty: You can only remove a group without members and without open invitations.
common_refusal_group_not_found: This stakeholder group no longer exists.
common_refusal_merge_values_conflict: The proposed values do not fit the data type of the element that stays.
common_refusal_not_found: This does not exist, or you have no access to it.
common_refusal_panel_locked: The change class and the minimum panel are fixed once the first round has opened.
common_refusal_previous_round_not_closed: Close the previous round before you start a new one.
common_refusal_raters_hidden: This round does not show who gave which rating.
common_refusal_reason_required: The panel is below the minimum. Give a reason to open the round anyway.
common_refusal_round_has_no_elements: Add at least one element to the round before you open it.
common_refusal_round_not_closed: The results show once the round is closed.
common_refusal_round_not_draft: This round has opened, so you can no longer change it.
common_refusal_round_not_due: You can close this round only after its closing date.
common_refusal_rule_invalid: The consensus rule is not valid. Check its thresholds.
common_refusal_scope_source_order_mismat: The list of sources changed while you sorted it. Reload the page and try again.
common_refusal_score_out_of_scale: This score is outside the scale of the round.
common_refusal_unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
common_refusal_value_number_not_allowed: The values of a coded text element have no number.
common_refusal_value_number_not_integer: The numbers of an ordinal element must be whole numbers.
common_refusal_value_number_required: Each value of an ordinal or scale element needs a number.
common_refusal_values_not_allowed: Only coded text, ordinal and scale elements have proposed values.
export_csv_commas: The CSV files are UTF-8 text with commas between the values.
export_csv_excel: A spreadsheet program set to Dutch expects semicolons. In Excel, open the file with Data, From Text/CSV, and choose Comma as the delimiter.
export_csv_libreoffice: LibreOffice Calc asks for the separator when it opens the file: tick Comma.
export_elements_description: One row per element with its data types, cardinality, sources, CKM link and the outcome of each round.
export_mind_map_description: The included elements as a FreeMind mind map (.mm), which Freeplane and XMind open.
export_purpose: Download the elements, the mind map and the ratings for the modellers and the study report.
export_ratings_description: One row per rating from the closed rounds, with a random participant code instead of a name.
invite_invalid: This invitation was used, revoked or has expired. Ask the facilitator of the project for a new one.
invite_next: Sign in with the e-mail address the invitation was sent to. Signing in accepts the invitation.
invite_pending: You are invited to take part in the project {project}.
mail_invitation_body:
You are invited to take part in the cdm-plenum project {project}, in the stakeholder group {group}.

Open this link to accept the invitation:

{url}

The invitation expires after {hours} hours.
members_purpose: The stakeholder groups of the project, who takes part in each, and the open invitations.
projects_description: The projects you take part in, with your role and the phase each project is in.
projects_empty_facilitator: Create a project for the clinical concept your group works on.
projects_empty_participant: You see a project here once you accept an invitation. Ask the facilitator of your project for one.
projects_name_description: For example the concept, such as Blood pressure. At most {max} characters.
projects_name_required: Enter a name for the project.
projects_new_description: A project covers one clinical concept. You become its facilitator.
rounds_agreement_help: The share of scores that must fall in one band.
rounds_bottom_band_help: Scores from the lowest score up to and including this score count as not important.
rounds_by_participant_caption: Each participant's ratings in this round. Only the facilitator sees this table, because the round allows it.
rounds_change_class_a_description: The model stays as it is; the group checks it against current practice.
rounds_change_class_b_description: A small change to an existing model, such as one extra element or a clearer description.
rounds_change_class_c_description: A large change to an existing model, such as several new elements or a new structure.
rounds_change_class_d: D, large change or new model
rounds_change_class_d_description: A new model, or a change so large that the model is almost new. New projects start in this class.
rounds_change_class_help: The class sets the minimum panel, after the Nictiz management agreements for zibs.
rounds_close_due: The closing date has passed, so nobody can rate any more. Close the round to calculate the outcomes.
rounds_close_explained: Closing calculates the outcome of each element under the rule of the round, and everyone in the project then sees the results. You cannot undo this.
rounds_close_not_due: You can close this round after its closing date. Until then, participants can still rate.
rounds_closes_at_future: The closing date must be in the future.
rounds_closes_at_help: In your time zone, {zone}. After this moment nobody can rate.
rounds_closes_at_required: Enter the closing date and time.
rounds_elements_board_empty: The board has no elements yet. Add them on the element board first.
rounds_elements_help: Participants rate every element you select.
rounds_elements_required: Choose at least one element to rate.
rounds_empty_facilitator: Start the first round when the board holds the candidate elements.
rounds_empty_participant: The facilitator has not opened a round yet. You can rate once a round is open.
rounds_fixed_after_opening: Once the round is open, the elements, the rule, the closing date and this setting can no longer change.
rounds_minimum_help: Leave a field empty to use the default of the change class.
rounds_minimum_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}, or leave the field empty.
rounds_minimum_legend: Minimum per expert type for this project
rounds_new_description: Choose the elements, the rule and the closing date. The round stays a draft until you open it.
rounds_new_description_next: The elements without consensus in round {number} are selected. The round stays a draft until you open it.
rounds_one_at_a_time: One round runs at a time. Close round {number} before you start a new one.
rounds_open_below_minimum: The panel is below the minimum for this change class:
rounds_open_fixed: After opening, the elements, the rule, the closing date and the setting for who rated what can no longer change.
rounds_open_intro: When you open the round, participants can rate until the closing date.
rounds_open_reason_help: The reason is stored with the round and shown in the decision report. At most {max} characters.
rounds_open_reason_label: Reason for opening below the minimum
rounds_open_reason_required: Give a reason to open the round below the minimum.
rounds_open_shortfall_hint: The panel is below the minimum. You can still open the round: you give a reason when you open it.
rounds_opened_below_minimum: Round {number} is open below the minimum. The reason is saved.
rounds_opposition_help: The largest share of scores allowed in the other band.
rounds_page_description: The setup of this round, how far the participants are, and the results once the round is closed.
rounds_panel_caption: Participants who joined, per expert type, next to the minimum
rounds_panel_intro: Change class {changeClass}. The minimum panel is a guideline: you can open a round below it when you give a reason.
rounds_panel_locked: The change class and the minimum are fixed, because a round has opened.
rounds_panel_meets_minimum: The panel meets the minimum for every expert type.
rounds_percentage_invalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with at most two decimals.
rounds_purpose: The Delphi rounds in which the group rates the elements, and the results of closed rounds.
rounds_rate_autosave: Your answers are saved as you go. You can change them until the round closes.
rounds_rate_bands: {bottomFrom} to {bottomTo}: not important. {topFrom} to {topTo}: critical. The scores in between: important, but not critical.
rounds_rate_intro: Rate how important each element is for the model. Each choice is saved at once.
rounds_rate_not_open: This round is no longer open, so you cannot change your ratings.
rounds_rate_reason_help: Saved when you leave the field. In the next round other participants see it without your name. At most {max} characters.
rounds_rate_reason_help_unrated: Choose a score or "unable to rate" first. The reason is saved with it.
rounds_rate_visible_title: The facilitator can see your ratings
rounds_raters_hidden: Nobody can see who gave which rating, the facilitator included.
rounds_raters_visible: The facilitator can see who gave which rating. Other participants cannot.
rounds_response_caption: Participants per stakeholder group: invited (joined before the round closed), started (at least one answer) and completed (an answer for every element).
rounds_result_no_groups: No stakeholder group has 3 or more scores on this element, so only the overall result shows.
rounds_results_after_close: The results show once the round is closed.
rounds_results_intro: Per element: the outcome under the rule, the median, the share in each band and every score. A stakeholder group with fewer than 3 scores counts only in the overall result.
rounds_rule_default_explained: The default is a scale from 1 to 9 with the rule of the COMET Handbook: an element is included when at least 70% score 7 to 9 and at most 15% score 1 to 3, and excluded the other way round. You can change the scale and every threshold until the round opens.
rounds_rule_error_agreement_not_above_ha: Agreement must be more than 50% and at most 100%.
rounds_rule_error_bands_outside_scale: The bands must lie within the scale.
rounds_rule_error_bands_overlap: The top band must start above the end of the bottom band.
rounds_rule_error_opposition_not_below_a: Opposition must be lower than agreement.
rounds_rule_error_scale_not_integer: The scale and the bands use whole numbers.
rounds_rule_error_scale_too_short: The highest score must be above the lowest score.
rounds_rule_excluded: Excluded when at least {agreement}% score {bottom} and at most {opposition}% score {top}.
rounds_rule_in_words_pending: Correct the values above to see the rule.
rounds_rule_included: Included when at least {agreement}% score {top} and at most {opposition}% score {bottom}.
rounds_rule_otherwise: Otherwise: no consensus. "Unable to rate" does not count toward the percentages.
rounds_score_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
rounds_sees_raters_help: Participants see this setting before they rate. Other participants never see who gave which rating. Leave it off unless your study needs it.
rounds_sees_raters_label: The facilitator may see who gave which rating
rounds_snapshot_caption: Participants per expert type when the round opened, next to the minimum that applied
rounds_snapshot_reason: Reason for opening below the minimum
rounds_top_band_help: Scores from this score up to and including the highest score count as critical.
scope_purpose: The scope statement of the concept: what it covers, its use cases, what is out of scope and the sources.
shell_sign_out_failed: Signing out did not work. Try again.
sign_in_check_inbox: If this address may sign in, a sign-in link is on its way to {email}. The link works once and expires after {minutes} minutes.
sign_in_error_failed: The sign-in link could not be sent. Try again.
sign_in_error_invalid_link: This sign-in link was used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
sign_in_error_not_invited: This e-mail address has no invitation. Ask the facilitator of your project for one.
sign_in_intro: Enter your e-mail address and you get a link to sign in. To sign in for the first time, you need an invitation to a project.
